---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL OAProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL OASeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

\* The control invariant records the single, non-recursive eviction frame.
OAEvictLabels == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
OALabels == OAEvictLabels \cup
    {"pick", "put", "waitEv", "endWEv", "chkSnc", "cntns", "onSnc",
     "insrt", "isMth", "cas", "tryEv", "waitIns", "endEv", "Done"}

OAControl ==
    /\ pc \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
    /\ fp \in [ProcSet -> fps \cup {0}]
    /\ \A s \in ProcSet : pc[s] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[s] \in fps
    /\ stack = [s \in ProcSet |->
          IF pc[s] \in OAEvictLabels THEN <<Head(stack[s])>> ELSE <<>>]
    /\ \A s \in ProcSet :
          pc[s] \in OAEvictLabels => Head(stack[s]).pc = "endEv"

OACompleteInv == OAControl /\ history \subseteq fps /\ CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OASingletonConcat == \A x : <<x>> \o <<>> = <<x>>
<1>1. TAKE x
<1>2. <<x>> \in Seq({x})
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1")
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, OASeq!ConcatEmptySeq, OAProof!SMTT("r1")

LEMMA OACompleteInit == Init => OACompleteInv
BY OAProof!SMTT("r10")
   DEF Init, OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
       ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OACompleteStep == OACompleteInv /\ [Next]_vars => OACompleteInv'
<1>1. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet, pick(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  <2>1. pc' \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, pick
  <2>2. fp' \in [ProcSet -> fps \cup {0}]
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, pick
  <2>3. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, pick
  <2>4. stack' = [t \in ProcSet |-> IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels THEN <<Head(stack'[t])>> ELSE <<>>]
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, pick
  <2>5. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels => Head(stack'[t]).pc = "endEv"
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, pick
  <2>6. history' \subseteq fps /\ CompleteAsSafety'
    <3>1. (history \subseteq fps /\ fps \ history = {}) => history = fps
      BY OAProof!SMTT("r1"), OAProof!SetExtensionality
    <3>2. /\ history' = history
           /\ history \subseteq fps
           /\ CompleteAsSafety
           /\ pc \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
      BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, pick
    <3>3. pc'[s] = "Done" => history' = fps
      BY <1>1, <3>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF pick
    <3>4. \A t \in ProcSet \ {s} : pc'[t] = pc[t]
      BY <1>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF pick
    <3>5. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF CompleteAsSafety
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl

<1>2. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet, cas(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  <2>1. pc' \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
    BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, cas
  <2>2. fp' \in [ProcSet -> fps \cup {0}]
    BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, cas
  <2>3. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps
    BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, cas
  <2>4. stack' = [t \in ProcSet |-> IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels THEN <<Head(stack'[t])>> ELSE <<>>]
    BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, cas
  <2>5. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels => Head(stack'[t]).pc = "endEv"
    BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, cas
  <2>6. history' \subseteq fps /\ CompleteAsSafety'
    <3>1. history \subseteq history' /\ history' \subseteq fps
      BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
         DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, cas
    <3>2. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] = "Done" => pc[t] = "Done"
      BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
         DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, cas
    <3>3. history = fps => history' = fps
      BY <3>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1"), OAProof!SetExtensionality
    <3>4. QED
      BY <1>2, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
         DEF OACompleteInv, CompleteAsSafety
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl

<1>3. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet, waitIns(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  <2>1. pc' \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
    BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>2. fp' \in [ProcSet -> fps \cup {0}]
    BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>3. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps
    BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>4. stack' = [t \in ProcSet |-> IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels THEN <<Head(stack'[t])>> ELSE <<>>]
    <3>1. stack[s] = <<>>
      BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
         DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OAEvictLabels, waitIns, ProcSet
    <3>2. stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![s] =
        <<[procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv",
           ei |-> ei[s], ej |-> ej[s], lo |-> lo[s]]>>]
      BY <1>3, <3>1, OASingletonConcat, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF waitIns
    <3>3. QED
      BY <1>3, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
         DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
             ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>5. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels => Head(stack'[t]).pc = "endEv"
    BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>6. history' \subseteq fps /\ CompleteAsSafety'
    BY <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl

<1>4. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet, rtrn(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  <2>1. pc' \in [ProcSet -> OALabels]
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>2. fp' \in [ProcSet -> fps \cup {0}]
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>3. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>4. stack' = [t \in ProcSet |-> IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels THEN <<Head(stack'[t])>> ELSE <<>>]
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>5. \A t \in ProcSet : pc'[t] \in OAEvictLabels => Head(stack'[t]).pc = "endEv"
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>6. history' \subseteq fps /\ CompleteAsSafety'
    BY <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl

<1>5. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet,
            strIns(s) \/ nestedIns(s) \/ set(s) \/ flush(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  BY <1>5, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush
<1>6. ASSUME OACompleteInv, NEW s \in ProcSet,
            put(s) \/ waitEv(s) \/ endWEv(s) \/ chkSnc(s) \/ cntns(s)
            \/ onSnc(s) \/ insrt(s) \/ isMth(s) \/ tryEv(s) \/ endEv(s)
      PROVE OACompleteInv'
  BY <1>6, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, OALabels, OAEvictLabels,
         ProcSet, CompleteAsSafety, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns,
         onSnc, insrt, isMth, tryEv, endEv

<1>7. OACompleteInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => OACompleteInv'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF OACompleteInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety, vars
<1>8. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF Next, Evict, p, Terminating, ProcSet

\* Scalar types are sufficient for the independent sorting invariant.
OATableValues == Int \cup {empty}
OAData ==
    /\ table \in [1..K -> OATableValues]
    /\ ei \in [ProcSet -> Int]
    /\ ej \in [ProcSet -> Int]
    /\ lo \in [ProcSet -> OATableValues]
    /\ \A s \in ProcSet : pc[s] \in OAEvictLabels =>
          /\ Head(stack[s]).ei \in Int
          /\ Head(stack[s]).ej \in Int
          /\ Head(stack[s]).lo \in OATableValues

LEMMA OAModType == \A i \in Int : mod(i,K) \in 1..K
BY OAAssumption, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF mod

LEMMA OADataInit == Init => OAData
BY OAProof!SMTT("r2")
   DEF Init, OAData, OATableValues, ProcSet, OAEvictLabels

LEMMA OADataStep == OAControl /\ OAData /\ [Next]_vars => OAData'
<1>1. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, strIns(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  <2>1. table[mod(ei[s]+1,K)] \in OATableValues
    BY <1>1, OAModType, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAData, ProcSet
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, strIns
<1>2. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, nestedIns(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>2, OAModType, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, nestedIns
<1>3. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, set(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>3, OAModType, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, set
<1>4. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, flush(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  <2>1. table[mod(ei[s],K)] \in OATableValues
    BY <1>4, OAModType, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAData, ProcSet
  <2>2. /\ lo' \in [ProcSet -> OATableValues]
         /\ (ei[s] <= K+L => lo'[s] = table[mod(ei[s],K)])
    BY <1>4, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAData, flush
  <2>3. table' \in [1..K -> OATableValues]
    BY <1>4, <2>1, <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r3")
       DEF OAData, flush, OATableValues
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>4, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, flush
<1>5. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, rtrn(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>5, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, rtrn
<1>6. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, waitIns(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>6, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, waitIns
<1>7. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet, cas(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>7, OAAssumption, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet, cas
<1>8. ASSUME OAControl, OAData, NEW s \in ProcSet,
            pick(s) \/ put(s) \/ waitEv(s) \/ endWEv(s) \/ chkSnc(s)
            \/ cntns(s) \/ onSnc(s) \/ insrt(s) \/ isMth(s) \/ tryEv(s) \/ endEv(s)
      PROVE OAData'
  BY <1>8, OAProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF OAControl, OAData, OATableValues, OAEvictLabels, ProcSet,
         pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, tryEv, endEv
<1>9. OAData /\ UNCHANGED vars => OAData'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAData, vars
<1>10. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9,
     OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF Next, Evict, p, Terminating, ProcSet

\* Sequence filtering and merge lemmas.
OARange(q) == {q[i] : i \in 1..Len(q)}
OAIncreasing(q) == \A i,j \in 1..Len(q) : i < j => q[i] < q[j]
OASortedSeq(q) == q \in Seq(Int) /\ OAIncreasing(q)

LEMMA OAAppendFacts ==
  \A q \in Seq(Int), e \in Int :
    /\ (OAIncreasing(Append(q,e)) =>
           OAIncreasing(q) /\ (\A x \in OARange(q) : x < e))
    /\ (OAIncreasing(q) /\ (\A x \in OARange(q) : x < e)
           => OAIncreasing(Append(q,e)))
<1>1. TAKE q \in Seq(Int), e \in Int
<1>2. /\ Len(q) \in Nat
       /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
       /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,e)[i] = q[i]
       /\ Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1] = e
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1")
<1>3. ASSUME OAIncreasing(Append(q,e))
      PROVE OAIncreasing(q) /\ (\A x \in OARange(q) : x < e)
  <2>1. OAIncreasing(q)
    BY <1>2, <1>3, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAIncreasing
  <2>2. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] < e
    <3>1. TAKE i \in 1..Len(q)
    <3>2. i \in 1..Len(Append(q,e)) /\
           Len(q)+1 \in 1..Len(Append(q,e)) /\ i < Len(q)+1
      BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
    <3>3. Append(q,e)[i] < Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1]
      BY <1>3, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAIncreasing
    <3>4. QED BY <1>2, <3>3, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OARange
<1>4. OAIncreasing(q) /\ (\A x \in OARange(q) : x < e)
           => OAIncreasing(Append(q,e))
  BY <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAIncreasing, OARange
<1>5. QED BY <1>3, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r2")

LEMMA OALargestFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(Int), OAIncreasing(q)
  PROVE /\ largestElem(q) \in Int
        /\ \A x \in OARange(q) : x <= largestElem(q)
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAIncreasing, OARange, largestElem, last

LEMMA OAConcatFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Seq(Int), NEW b \in Seq(Int),
         OAIncreasing(a), OAIncreasing(b),
         \A x \in OARange(a), y \in OARange(b) : x < y
  PROVE OASortedSeq(a \o b)
<1>1. /\ a \o b \in Seq(Int)
       /\ Len(a) \in Nat /\ Len(b) \in Nat
       /\ Len(a \o b) = Len(a)+Len(b)
       /\ \A k \in 1..Len(a \o b) :
            (a \o b)[k] = IF k <= Len(a) THEN a[k] ELSE b[k-Len(a)]
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r2")
<1>2. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(a \o b), NEW j \in 1..Len(a \o b), i < j
      PROVE (a \o b)[i] < (a \o b)[j]
  <2>1. CASE j <= Len(a)
    <3>1. /\ i \in 1..Len(a) /\ j \in 1..Len(a)
           /\ (a \o b)[i] = a[i] /\ (a \o b)[j] = a[j]
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
    <3>2. a[i] < a[j]
      BY <1>2, <3>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAIncreasing
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
  <2>2. CASE i > Len(a)
    <3>1. /\ i-Len(a) \in 1..Len(b) /\ j-Len(a) \in 1..Len(b)
           /\ i-Len(a) < j-Len(a)
           /\ (a \o b)[i] = b[i-Len(a)] /\ (a \o b)[j] = b[j-Len(a)]
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
    <3>2. b[i-Len(a)] < b[j-Len(a)]
      BY <3>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAIncreasing
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
  <2>3. CASE i <= Len(a) /\ j > Len(a)
    <3>1. /\ i \in 1..Len(a) /\ j-Len(a) \in 1..Len(b)
           /\ (a \o b)[i] = a[i] /\ (a \o b)[j] = b[j-Len(a)]
      BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
    <3>2. a[i] \in OARange(a) /\ b[j-Len(a)] \in OARange(b)
      BY <3>1, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OARange
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
  <2>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r1")
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq, OAIncreasing

LEMMA OASelectAbove ==
  ASSUME NEW lower \in Int
  PROVE \A q \in Seq(Int) :
    /\ SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
    /\ OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(q)
    /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)) : x > lower
    /\ (OAIncreasing(q) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)))
<1> DEFINE OAPropSelectAbove(q) ==
    /\ SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
    /\ OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(q)
    /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)) : x > lower
    /\ (OAIncreasing(q) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)))
<1>1. OAPropSelectAbove(<<>>)
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAPropSelectAbove, OARange, OAIncreasing
<1>2. ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, OAPropSelectAbove(q)
      PROVE OAPropSelectAbove(Append(q,e))
  <2>1. SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x > lower) =
          IF e > lower THEN Append(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower),e) ELSE SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x > lower)
    BY OAProof!SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. /\ SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
         /\ OARange(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(Append(q,e))
         /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x > lower)) : x > lower
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAPropSelectAbove, OARange
  <2>3. OAIncreasing(Append(q,e)) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x > lower))
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAAppendFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAPropSelectAbove
  <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAPropSelectAbove
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OASeq!SequencesInductionAppend, OAProof!Isa DEF OAPropSelectAbove

LEMMA OASelectBetween ==
  ASSUME NEW lower \in Int, NEW upper \in Int
  PROVE \A q \in Seq(Int) :
    /\ SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
    /\ OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(q)
    /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) : x < upper /\ x > lower
    /\ (OAIncreasing(q) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)))
<1> DEFINE OAPropSelectBetween(q) ==
    /\ SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
    /\ OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(q)
    /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) : x < upper /\ x > lower
    /\ (OAIncreasing(q) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)))
<1>1. OAPropSelectBetween(<<>>)
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAPropSelectBetween, OARange, OAIncreasing
<1>2. ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, OAPropSelectBetween(q)
      PROVE OAPropSelectBetween(Append(q,e))
  <2>1. SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower) =
          IF e < upper /\ e > lower THEN Append(SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower),e) ELSE SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)
    BY OAProof!SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. /\ SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower) \in Seq(Int)
         /\ OARange(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) \subseteq OARange(Append(q,e))
         /\ \A x \in OARange(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower)) : x < upper /\ x > lower
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAPropSelectBetween, OARange
  <2>3. OAIncreasing(Append(q,e)) => OAIncreasing(SelectSeq(Append(q,e),LAMBDA x : x < upper /\ x > lower))
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAAppendFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAPropSelectBetween
  <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OAPropSelectBetween
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OASeq!SequencesInductionAppend, OAProof!Isa DEF OAPropSelectBetween

LEMMA OASelectNonempty == \A q \in Seq(Int) :
    SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x # empty) = q
<1> DEFINE OAIdentity(q) == SelectSeq(q,LAMBDA x : x # empty) = q
<1>1. OAIdentity(<<>>)
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAIdentity
<1>2. ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, OAIdentity(q)
      PROVE OAIdentity(Append(q,e))
  BY <1>2, EmptyNotInt, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OAIdentity
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OASeq!SequencesInductionAppend, OAProof!Isa DEF OAIdentity

LEMMA OAFlushAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, NEW e \in Int,
         OASortedSeq(a), OASortedSeq(b), largestElem(b) < e
  PROVE OASortedSeq(Append(b \o subSeqSmaller(a,b,e),e))
<1> DEFINE OAFloor == largestElem(b)
           OAChunk == SelectSeq(a,LAMBDA x : x < e /\ x > OAFloor)
<1>1. /\ OAFloor \in Int
       /\ \A x \in OARange(b) : x <= OAFloor
  BY OALargestFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OASortedSeq, OAFloor
<1>2. /\ OAChunk \in Seq(Int)
       /\ OAIncreasing(OAChunk)
       /\ \A x \in OARange(OAChunk) : x < e /\ x > OAFloor
  BY <1>1, OASelectBetween, OAProof!IsaM("blast")
     DEF OAChunk, OASortedSeq
<1>3. OASortedSeq(b \o OAChunk)
  <2>1. \A x \in OARange(b), y \in OARange(OAChunk) : x < y
    BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq, OARange
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAConcatFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq
<1>4. \A x \in OARange(b \o OAChunk) : x < e
  <2>1. \A x \in OARange(b) : x < e
    BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OARange, OASortedSeq, OAFloor
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>2, <1>3, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OARange, OASortedSeq
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4, OAAppendFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
     DEF OAChunk, OAFloor, subSeqSmaller, OASortedSeq

LEMMA OAFlushFinish ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, OASortedSeq(a), OASortedSeq(b)
  PROVE OASortedSeq(b \o subSeqLarger(a,b))
<1>1. CASE b = <<>>
  BY <1>1, OASeq!ConcatEmptySeq, OAProof!SMTT("r2")
     DEF subSeqLarger, OASortedSeq
<1>2. CASE b # <<>>
  <2> DEFINE OAFloor2 == largestElem(b)
             OARest == SelectSeq(a,LAMBDA x : x > OAFloor2)
  <2>1. /\ OAFloor2 \in Int
         /\ \A x \in OARange(b) : x <= OAFloor2
    BY OALargestFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OASortedSeq, OAFloor2
  <2>2. /\ OARest \in Seq(Int)
         /\ OAIncreasing(OARest)
         /\ \A x \in OARange(OARest) : x > OAFloor2
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OASelectAbove, OAProof!IsaM("blast")
       DEF OARest, OASortedSeq
  <2>3. \A x \in OARange(b), y \in OARange(OARest) : x < y
    BY <2>1, <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq, OARange
  <2>4. OASortedSeq(b \o OARest)
    BY <2>2, <2>3, OAConcatFacts, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq
  <2>5. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>4, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OARest, OAFloor2, subSeqLarger
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r2")

LEMMA OASortedSeqImplies ==
  ASSUME NEW q, OASortedSeq(q)
  PROVE isSorted(q)
BY OASelectNonempty, OAProof!SMTT("r2") DEF OASortedSeq, isSorted, OAIncreasing

LEMMA OASortedStateStep == OAData /\ OASortedState /\ [Next]_vars => OASortedState'
<1>1. ASSUME OAData, OASortedState, NEW s \in ProcSet, flush(s)

  <2>1. table[mod(ei[s],K)] \in OATableValues

    BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF OASortedSeq, OAIncreasing
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, OAFlushAppend, OAFlushFinish, OAProof!SMTT("r5")

<1>4. QED
